summary: Backend-only LAMA iteration-2 testing. 20 pytest tests across 6 classes: service rename, KB folder scan (incl. SKIP_DIRS + SKIP_FILE_PATTERNS), chat intent + auto-SRS-trigger, TOON pruning non-crash, GitHub config/test/push, regression. 19/20 passed (95%). 1 failure surfaces a real contract bug in scan-folder skip reporting (see backend_issues.critical).

critical.issue: SKIP_FILE_PATTERNS (.bak, .save, .php_*, _old/_bkp/_backup) are effectively unreachable when the file's extension is NOT in ALLOWED_EXTS. In routes/kb.py the extension check runs FIRST and `continue`s silently, so files like `old.bak`, `notes.save`, `Legacy.php_03Mar2025` are filtered out without ever being added to `skipped_files`. The review request explicitly states these should appear in the skipped list. Fix: run `_should_skip_file(f)` BEFORE the `ext not in ALLOWED_EXTS` filter, OR also append unknown-extension files matching skip patterns to `skipped`.

minor.issue: Accepts raw dict payload — no Pydantic model; weaker validation and missing OpenAPI schema.
Token is stored in plaintext on the project document (acknowledged in code comment). Acceptable for pilot, but flag for production.
When intent='srs.generate' the auto-trigger silently swallows ALL exceptions and just sets srs_triggered=false — no error surfaced to client. Hard to debug failed auto-generation.
Returns 200 with status='error' for all failure cases (no repo/token, no SRS, push failure). Inconsistent with REST norms; clients must inspect body.
token_preview is `token[:6] + '…'` — for a real PAT (ghp_xxxx...) this leaks the first 6 chars; consider showing last 4 instead.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): /app/backend/routes/kb.py scan-folder — reorder checks so SKIP_FILE_PATTERNS are evaluated before the ALLOWED_EXTS filter, so .bak/.save/.php_*/_old/_bkp/_backup files placed in source folder are reported in `skipped_files`. Current behavior silently drops them.
(Optional) Use Pydantic request models for /api/kb/scan-folder, /api/kb/build (still dict).
(Optional) Surface a meaningful error message in chat response when srs.generate auto-trigger fails (currently silently set to false).
(Optional) Consider returning 4xx codes from /api/github/push error paths instead of 200+status=error.

rca of the issue: Bug: scan-folder skipped_files omits .bak/.save/.php_* files. RCA: In /app/backend/routes/kb.py the loop checks `ext not in ALLOWED_EXTS` first (`continue` without recording) before `_should_skip_file(f)`. Since .bak/.save/.php_03Mar2025 have extensions NOT in ALLOWED_EXTS, they are dropped silently — never reaching the skip-pattern branch that would append to `skipped`. Reproduction: POST /api/kb/scan-folder with a folder containing `old.bak` and `notes.save` — response shows skipped count missing those files. Mitigation: swap the order — evaluate `_should_skip_file(f)` first; if match, `skipped.append(f); continue`. Then apply extension filter.
